Operation names say what they do with a problem:

| Prefix | What it does | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `prepare*` | builds a checked transaction ([`Prepared`](../reference/types/send.md#Prepared)); throws for an error, reports findings in `checks`; sends nothing | [`deposits.prepareDeposit`](../reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit), [`ovm.prepareWithdraw`](../reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw), [`splits.prepareDistributeAll`](../reference/splits.md#prepareDistributeAll) |
| `preview*` | the same reads and checks as its `prepare*`, returning `{ preview, checks, blockNumber }` and no transaction | [`ovm.previewDistribute`](../reference/ovm.md#previewDistribute), [`splits.previewDistributeAll`](../reference/splits.md#previewDistributeAll) |
| `verify*` | checks untrusted input and **returns** a result object (always truthy: read `.ok`); throws only for malformed input | [`cluster.verifyLock`](../reference/cluster.md#verifyLock), [`cluster.verifyDefinition`](../reference/cluster.md#verifyDefinition) |
| `isValid*` | the same as a boolean | `isValidLock`, [`cluster.isValidEnr`](../reference/cluster.md#isValidEnr), `isValidTypedDataSignature` |
| `assert*` | checks and **throws** when the check fails; for use before a write | [`deposits.assertDepositData`](../reference/deposits.md#assertDepositData), [`exits.assertPartialExit`](../reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit) |
| `get*` | reads | [`ovm.getState`](../reference/ovm.md#getState), [`ovm.getProvenance`](../reference/ovm.md#getProvenance), [`splits.getSplit`](../reference/splits.md#getSplit), [`cluster.getLock`](../reference/cluster.md#getLock) |
| `compute*` | pure hashing | [`cluster.computeConfigHash`](../reference/cluster.md#computeConfigHash) |
